My research agenda focuses on political representation and gender, cabinets and ministerial recruitment, political parties and political finance, with an emphasis on Latin America. I work with comparative politics approaches and the production of evidence for academic debates and public policy discussions.

## Master’s thesis

**Presidential strategies, participation, and integration. Women’s appointments to Latin American cabinets (1999–2019)** (UTDT, 2021).\
Comparative analysis of 18 countries (1999–2019) on gender integration in presidential cabinets.

[View record in the UTDT Repository](https://repositorio.utdt.edu/handle/20.500.13098/12017){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## Research projects

**Presidential Cabinets Project**\
I am part of this collaborative comparative politics project focused on the composition, formation, and dynamics of presidential cabinets in the Americas.

[Project description](https://pex-network.com/2018/08/16/government-formation-and-minister-turnover-in-presidential-cabinets-comparative-analysis-in-the-americas/){target="_blank"}

## Research experience

-   **Doctoral Fellow — UBACyT and CONICET**\
    **Gioja Institute, Faculty of Law, University of Buenos Aires (UBA)** \| *2018–2024*\
    Conducted doctoral research, producing academic work on political institutions, representation, and gender.

-   **Co-Director — Project “Women’s Political Careers in Subnational Contexts”**\
    **Universidad Torcuato Di Tella (UTDT)** \| *2021–2022*\
    Co-led a project aimed at understanding women’s trajectories and the conditions of access to power at the subnational level.

-   **Researcher — PIDAE Project “Legislation on Political Parties in Argentina”**\
    **Faculty of Law, University of Buenos Aires (UBA)** \| *2019–2022*\
    Research on party regulation: legal mapping, systematization, and analysis of reform debates.

-   **Associate Researcher — UBACyT Project “Political Coalitions in Latin America”**\
    **University of Buenos Aires (UBA)** \| *2016–2018*\
    Participated in comparative research on political coalitions in the region.
